nullRetry.observation: An isolated production steering control retried 180 null paths in 180 ticks. Its scav was above the panic threshold, so this is not a normal full-AI freeze claim. The !path retry condition already existed at d19; the new stop behavior exposed it.
nullRetry.latestObservation: After cooldown and prefix changes, diffuse 227..474 ppm air over a 20 m route yields a safe partial path and actual full AI moves 4.0875 m in three seconds, with six searches and no panic. This limited success does not close the wall-detour failure below.

followupChanges.prefixCandidateCounts: Historical prefix arrays were not completed-route evidence. The resumable implementation again returns null from synchronous findPath when one step is incomplete; actual AI completion is measured via its PathSearch jobs and trajectories.

probeRepairLog.error: First run incorrectly addressed City.world, which is undefined; it aborted before producing evidence.
probeRepairLog.correction: Read actual City and Game assignment and used City.collision. Successful rerun is the recorded evidence; no product defect was assigned to the fixture error.

independentRefutation.conclusion: No additional confirmed defect within the tested source/CPU boundary. Interleaved searches match isolated paths/endpoints/expansion counts; live buffer reuse does not mutate job snapshots; source and moved-goal cancellation use the actual production steering method.
limits: A source rebake cancels the pending job after the nav grid publishes that source revision, not at the instant the gas is toggled.
A moved target cancels only after displacement exceeds 3.5 m; a 3 m change deliberately retains the current job.

A cost-only change preserves the pending snapshot to completion. Completion supplies one steering request from that older path, and the next steering call notices the live revision and starts a new search. This does not claim zero-lag response to wind/intensity changes.
The CPU step budget is not a physical-device frame-time measurement.

verdictScope: The four original source defects and the tested wall-prefix failure are closed within the recorded CPU/source scope; known halfVents yard issue and whole-element comparison are outside this PASS.

closedPrefixFailure.implementation: Each enemy keeps its open set, explored nodes and traversal-cost snapshot, continuing at most 700 expansions per simulation tick. Movement receives a completed path, not a heuristic prefix.
closedPrefixFailure.scope: Actual production Game/AISystem/Actor movement/collision on the same diagnostic wall layout and endpoint; no increased budget override. Synchronous path700 remains null correctly because one step is incomplete.
